dialogues.en: Knock knock.
dialogues.text: Knock knock.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きてますか？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, are you awake?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, are you awake?"

dialogues.jp: ドアを開け音夢が顔をだす。
dialogues.en: Nemu opens the door and comes in.
dialogues.text: Nemu opens the door and comes in.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、一応な」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, sort of."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, sort of."

dialogues.jp: 天井を見つめたまま答える。
dialogues.en: I reply, while staring up at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I reply, while staring up at the ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつまでも横になってるとまた寝ちゃうわよ」
dialogues.en: "If you don't get up now, you're gonna fall asleep again."
dialogues.text: "If you don't get up now, you're gonna fall asleep again."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……分かってるって」
dialogues.en: "......I know that."
dialogues.text: "......I know that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「下で待ってるから、早く来てね」
dialogues.en: "Hurry up, I'm gonna be waiting for you downstairs."
dialogues.text: "Hurry up, I'm gonna be waiting for you downstairs."

dialogues.jp: パタン
dialogues.en: Bang.
dialogues.text: Bang.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の遠ざかる足音を聞きながら、ゆっくりと
起き上がる。
dialogues.en: Hearing Nemu's retreating footsteps, I slowly get up.
dialogues.text: Hearing Nemu's retreating footsteps, I slowly get up.

dialogues.jp:
後ろ髪を引かれる思いで布団からでると、制服
を手に取る。
dialogues.en:
Getting out of the futon with painful reluctance, I reach
for my school uniform.
dialogues.text:
Getting out of the futon with painful reluctance, I reach
for my school uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったる」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... What a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... What a pain in the neck."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう、食べながら外を歩かないでよ。恥ずか
　しいんだから」
dialogues.en: "Don't walk while eating. It's embarrassing."
dialogues.text: "Don't walk while eating. It's embarrassing."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「しょうがないだろ。時間がなかったんだから」
dialogues.en: "I have no choice. I didn't have enough time."
dialogues.text: "I have no choice. I didn't have enough time."

dialogues.jp: パンをかじりながら、家の門をあける。
dialogues.en: I open the house gate, nibbling the bread.
dialogues.text: I open the house gate, nibbling the bread.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だったらもっと早く起きればいいんです」
dialogues.en: "Then you should have got up earlier."
dialogues.text: "Then you should have got up earlier."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、いつまでも｛にら／睨｝んでないでとっとと行こ
　うぜ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, just forget it, and let's go."
dialogues.text: "Come on, just forget it, and let's go."

dialogues.jp:
せっかく歩いていけるのに、走るハメになった
らバカらしい。
dialogues.en: We can't waste any more time or we'll have to run.
dialogues.text: We can't waste any more time or we'll have to run.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もぅ」
dialogues.en: "Argh."
dialogues.text: "Argh."

dialogues.jp:
音夢さんご立腹といった感じを見せつつも、素
直に横に並んでついてくる。
dialogues.en:
Although Nemu acts like she is angry, she still follows me
meekly, walking next to me.
dialogues.text:
Although Nemu acts like she is angry, she still follows me
meekly, walking next to me.

dialogues.jp:
と、校門の前まで来たところで、音夢が小さく
呟く。
dialogues.en: Coming to the school gate, Nemu murmurs.
dialogues.text: Coming to the school gate, Nemu murmurs.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の視線を｛たど／辿｝ると、眞子が柱に寄りかかって
いる姿が目についた。
dialogues.en: Following Nemu's eyes, I spot Mako leaning on a post.
dialogues.text: Following Nemu's eyes, I spot Mako leaning on a post.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、眞子じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's you, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's you, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 柱から身体を離し、俺のほうに身体をむける。
dialogues.en: Straightening up, Mako turns to face me.
dialogues.text: Straightening up, Mako turns to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう眞子」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん、おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Uh, yeah, good morning."
dialogues.text: "Uh, yeah, good morning."

dialogues.jp: 少し慌て気味に眞子が挨拶を返す。
dialogues.en: Mako returns the greeting in a bit of a hurry.
dialogues.text: Mako returns the greeting in a bit of a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんに用？」
dialogues.en: "Do you need to talk to my brother?"
dialogues.text: "Do you need to talk to my brother?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Uh, yeah......"
dialogues.text: "Uh, yeah......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そう。じゃあ兄さん、私は先に行きますね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. - Niisan, I'll see you then."
dialogues.text: "Okay. - Niisan, I'll see you then."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ」
dialogues.en: "Um? Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Um? Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
足早に去っていく音夢を気にかけつつも、眞子
に視線をもどす。
dialogues.en:
I look after Nemu, walking quickly away from us, and then
back at Mako.
dialogues.text:
I look after Nemu, walking quickly away from us, and then
back at Mako.

dialogues.jp: 「で、どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So what happened?"
dialogues.text: "So what happened?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の後姿を見つめる眞子に｛き／訊｝く。
dialogues.en: I asked Mako, who was gazing at Nemu's back.
dialogues.text: I asked Mako, who was gazing at Nemu's back.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、うん……」
dialogues.en: "What? Uh, yeah......"
dialogues.text: "What? Uh, yeah......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それが、またラブレターが届いて……」
dialogues.en: "I received another love letter......"
dialogues.text: "I received another love letter......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「また？」
dialogues.en: "Again?"
dialogues.text: "Again?"

dialogues.jp:
せっかく付き合ってるフリをしたってのに、無
駄だったってのか？
dialogues.en:
I was trying to pretend to be your boyfriend, but was it
useless?
dialogues.text:
I was trying to pretend to be your boyfriend, but was it
useless?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「相手の子、全然あたしたちのことに気づいて
　ないみたいなんだよね……」
dialogues.en:
"It seems that the girl hasn't found out about our
relationship yet......"
dialogues.text:
"It seems that the girl hasn't found out about our
relationship yet......"

dialogues.jp: 落胆気味に呟く眞子。
dialogues.en: Mako murmurs despondently.
dialogues.text: Mako murmurs despondently.

dialogues.jp: そのとき、桜並木のほうから杉並がやってきた。
dialogues.en: "Well, we didn't really make a big scene anyway."
dialogues.text: "Well, we didn't really make a big scene anyway."

dialogues.jp: さすがに勘だけは鋭い。
dialogues.en:
The only different thing we've started doing since we
decided to pretend to be a couple is to go home together. We
don't act lovey-dovey like a true couple would.
dialogues.text:
The only different thing we've started doing since we
decided to pretend to be a couple is to go home together. We
don't act lovey-dovey like a true couple would.

dialogues.jp:
どんな情報をつかんでいるのか、杉並がニヤリ
と笑う。
dialogues.en:
"It's been only two days since we started this. It's
probably too early to take it too seriously."
dialogues.text:
"It's been only two days since we started this. It's
probably too early to take it too seriously."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「早苗ちゃんは物事に執着する性格のようでな」
dialogues.en: "You may be right, but......"
dialogues.text: "You may be right, but......"

dialogues.jp:
かなり不安を煽るようなことを、杉並がさらり
と言う。
dialogues.en: Mako looks a bit troubled.
dialogues.text: Mako looks a bit troubled.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、どうしようか……？」
dialogues.en: "What do you think I should do?"
dialogues.text: "What do you think I should do?"

dialogues.jp:
変化といったら、せいぜい誘って一緒に帰るよ
うになったぐらいだ。
dialogues.en:
Looking up into my face, Mako looks as if she's depending on
me.
dialogues.text:
Looking up into my face, Mako looks as if she's depending on
me.

dialogues.jp:
別に本当のカップルみたいに甘ったるいオーラ
を周囲に振りまいているわけでもない。
dialogues.en: "......What's wrong with you?"
dialogues.text: "......What's wrong with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうかもしれないけど……」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: いまいち、不安が晴れない顔をする。
dialogues.en: She's so submissive.
dialogues.text: She's so submissive.

dialogues.jp:
俺の顔を見上げて、すがるような瞳を向けてく
る。
dialogues.en: "Well... Never mind."
dialogues.text: "Well... Never mind."

dialogues.jp: 「……どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why don't you just wait and see how it goes? There's no
point getting so worked up."
dialogues.text:
"Why don't you just wait and see how it goes? There's no
point getting so worked up."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
随分と、しおらしいじゃないか。
dialogues.en: "Well, just take it easy!"
dialogues.text: "Well, just take it easy!"

dialogues.jp: 「いや……なんでもない」
dialogues.en: I lightly give her a tap on the back.
dialogues.text: I lightly give her a tap on the back.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うーん……」
dialogues.en: "Hey... Why did you hit me like that?"
dialogues.text: "Hey... Why did you hit me like that?"

dialogues.jp: パシッ――と眞子の背中を軽く叩く。
dialogues.en:
"Rather than talking about pretending to be a couple,
remember that we won't even look like friends if you behave
so awkwardly."
dialogues.text:
"Rather than talking about pretending to be a couple,
remember that we won't even look like friends if you behave
so awkwardly."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「な……もう、何するのよっ」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm not acting awkwardly!"
dialogues.text: "I, I'm not acting awkwardly!"

dialogues.jp:
そう言いながら言葉を詰まらせる姿に、思わず
失笑しそうになるのを堪える。
dialogues.en:
Looking at Mako, who is at a loss for words, I hold back my
laughter.
dialogues.text:
Looking at Mako, who is at a loss for words, I hold back my
laughter.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、分かったからさっさと行くぞ。こんな
　ところで言い合いなんかしてたら、｛さら／晒｝し者も
　いいところだ」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, let's go. We'll look ridiculous if we keep arguing
here."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, let's go. We'll look ridiculous if we keep arguing
here."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、待ちなさいよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, wait!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, wait!"

dialogues.jp:
眞子に背中を向けている間に、堪えきれずにニ
ヤケだした顔を落ち着かせる。
dialogues.en:
As I turn my back on Mako, I try to fix my flirtatious
expression.
dialogues.text:
As I turn my back on Mako, I try to fix my flirtatious
expression.

dialogues.jp: （まったく、どうしたってんだ？）
dialogues.en: (What's wrong with me?)
dialogues.text: (What's wrong with me?)

dialogues.jp:
不思議とあったかな気分を味わいながら、昇降
口に向かう。
dialogues.en: Feeling somehow warm, I start walking toward the lobby.
dialogues.text: Feeling somehow warm, I start walking toward the lobby.

dialogues.jp:
後ろから聞こえる足音が、だんだんと気になる
ようになってきていた……。
dialogues.en:
Footsteps I hear behind me start bothering me little by
little......
dialogues.text:
Footsteps I hear behind me start bothering me little by
little......

dialogues.jp: ◆演技の効果◆

恋人のフリを続ける俺と眞子だったが、まだま
だ成果は出ていないらしい。

落ち込む眞子を励ました俺は、なんだかわから
ないがあったかな気分になったのだった。
